items.name: Capivarona Alto da XV Mall 2025

venue.name: [Alto da XV Mall](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kHXSt9QKiUNdo9j8A)
venue.address: R. Camões, 601 - Alto da XV, Curitiba - PR, 80045-320

items.information:
**PORTUGUÊS**
Sejam todos bem-vindos à segunda competição no Alto da XV Mall em parceria com o Capivara!

Essa competição terá como foco os "big cubes", portanto teremos tempos de corte generosos para que todos possam participar e se divertir. Também teremos premiação extra-oficial para as mulheres e os iniciantes melhores colocados na modalidade 3x3x3.

Nesta competição estamos arrecadando doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Todo o lucro da competição será revertido para esta campanha. Para mais informações, consulte a aba Campanha Beneficente.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).
Lembre-se de estar **pelo menos meia hora antes** de cada rodada que for participar e de fazer seu credenciamento no momento que chegar!

**ENGLISH**
Welcome to the second competition at Alto da XV Mall in partnership with Capivara!

This competition is going to have a focus on "big cubes", so we will have generous cutoff times so everyone can participate and have fun. We will also have unofficial awards to the best women and newcomers in the 3x3x3 event.

In this competition we are collecting donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. All profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. For more information, check the Charitable Campaign tab.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA).

It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Remember to be at the venue at least **thirty minutes before** each event you will participate and to check in at the moment you arrive!

items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d1f95f10cca6c70419c1d2f0af053c637d4fdb6f/Cubestuff%20Small-Photoroom.jpg)

You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.


## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. Check out the Groups tab for more information on competition groups.


## NOTICE OF FILMING

Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.


#### About CubingZA

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--32984d244f55e182cf16e089cf3f8466caffc2ac/image.png)

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, [please get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact)

### WCA Newcomer Month

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg)

[FR]
Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024.

Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants :

50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi.
Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens.
Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous.

[EN]
This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQ3NzUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b83885f0ca3e638334b1142605be9fcc75373ce5/newcm.png)
(SRB)
 
**Irig Newcommer Day 2025** je dvadeset i četvrto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. 

Ovo takmičenje učestvuje u zvaničnom **WCA Mesecu Novih Takmičara 2025**. Proces registracije obezbeđuje 50% mesta za nove takmičare. Novi takmičari su oni koji još nemaju WCA ID ili imaju WCA ID iz 2025. godine. Takmičari koji imaju WCA ID iz 2024. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Svi takmičari i dalje moraju ispuniti sve zahteve za prijavu kako bi njihova prijava bila smatrana potpunom.

**Prijave će se prihvatati na sledeći način:**
* 50% mesta, određenih ograničenjem broja takmičara, obezbeđeno je za nove takmičare.
* Ako se više od 50% novih takmičara prijavi pre nego što se preostalih 50% mesta popuni povratnicima, dalja prijava će se prihvatati uobičajenim redosledom za nove takmičare i povratnike istovremeno.
* Ako mesta obezbeđena za nove takmičare ne popune novi takmičari dve nedelje pre zatvaranja registracija, preostala mesta, do ograničenja broja takmičara, biće dodeljena prijavljenim povratnicima.

------------------------

(ENG)

**Irig Newcommer Day 2025** is the 24th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. 

This competition is participating in the official **WCA Newcomer Month 2025**. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες.

[IT]
Si tratta di una gara adatta ai principianti! Tutti sono i benvenuti, ma se non avete mai gareggiato prima d'ora, questa è la gara a cui iscriversi!

Questa gara fa parte del WCA Newcomer Month 2025. Il processo di iscrizione riserverà il 50% dei posti ai nuovi concorrenti. Per nuovi concorrenti si intende che non hanno un ID WCA o un ID WCA del 2025. I concorrenti che ritornano sono considerati in possesso di un ID WCA del 2024 o precedente. Tutti i concorrenti devono comunque rispettare tutti i requisiti di registrazione affinché la loro iscrizione sia considerata completa.

Le iscrizioni saranno accettate in base a quanto segue:

Il 50% dei posti, come definito dal limite dei concorrenti, è riservato ai nuovi concorrenti.
Inizialmente, il 50% dei posti, come definito dal limite dei concorrenti, è disponibile per i concorrenti che ritornano, in base all'ordine di arrivo.
Se più del 50% dei nuovi concorrenti si iscrive prima che il 50% dei posti sia occupato dai concorrenti che ritornano, ogni ulteriore nuovo concorrente sarà accettato in base all'ordine di arrivo, insieme ai concorrenti che ritornano.
Se i posti riservati ai nuovi concorrenti non vengono occupati da nuovi concorrenti prima della chiusura delle iscrizioni due settimane prima della gara, i posti rimanenti, fino al limite dei concorrenti, saranno accettati dai concorrenti già iscritti.

Questa gara è una competizione in serie con **Show Your Skills in Ponte Tresa 2025**. È possibile iscriversi e partecipare a una sola di queste gare.

# This competition features easy and popular events, making it perfect for newcomers.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA3NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1ce2d0d5715009d578d2d8e7e5719e7d7b032738/newcomers2025.png)

**First Time Competitors:**
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

* 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Judging:**
All competitors are expected to help at this competition. We will have a judging tutorial at the beginning of the day. All competitors will be assigned to judge 1 group of each of the events they are competing in. There will also be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done.

**Mystery event:**
There will be a mystery event at lunch. You only need to know how to solve a 3x3 to participate.

**4x4**
There will be no cutoff for 4x4 at this competition. The cumulative time limit is 20 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. 4x4 is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results.


---

We ask attendees to limit themselves to one guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 160 people.
Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time.
Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in.

Notice of Filming and Photography:
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

#### **Deutsch:**

Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2025 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

Day 1 (Friday) falls on Human Rights Day, making it the perfect opportunity to challenge yourself with events you don't always see - like Clock, Megaminx, and even 3x3 Blindfolded! If you're looking to try something new, this is your chance.

Day 2 (Saturday) is all about the fan favorites: Pyraminx, 2x2, and a full three rounds of 3x3. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to WCA events, there's something for you.

New to competing? No problem! We'll have a newcomer tutorial to walk you through competing and judging (yes, even first-timers help with judging). Just remember to bring a form of ID for registration. While most beginner-friendly events happen on Saturday, you're absolutely welcome to compete on Friday too!

Don't miss out - come test your skills, meet fellow cubers, and be part of Durban's cubing community!

#### Prijave će se prihvačati na sljedeći način:
* 50% mjesta određenih limitom broja natjecatelja, osigurano je za nove natjecatelje.
* Na početku je za povratnike na raspolaganju 50% mjesta, određenih limitom broja natjecatelja. Prijave će se primati uobičajenim redoslijedom po principu "tko prvi, njegovo".
* Ako se više od 50% novih natjecatelja prijavi prije nego što se preostalih 50% mjesta popuni povratnicima, daljnje prijave se prihvaćaju uobičajenim redoslijedom za nove natjecatelje i povratnike u isto vrijeme.
* Ako mjesta osigurana za nove natjecatelje ne popune novi natjecatelji dva tjedna prije zatvaranja registracija, preostala mjesta, do ograničenja natjecatelja, bit će prihvaćena od registriranih povratnika.

# Português
Esta competição está participando do Mês Oficial do Novato da WCA 2025. O processo de inscrição reservará 50% das vagas para novatos. Novatos são considerados como não tendo ID da WCA ou um ID da WCA com 2025. Os competidores veteranos são considerados como tendo um ID da WCA de 2024 ou anterior. Todos os competidores ainda devem seguir todos os requisitos de inscrição para que sua inscrição seja considerada completa.

As inscrições serão aceitas com base nos seguintes critérios:
* 50% das vagas (30 vagas) são inicialmente reservadas para competidores novatos.
* 50% das vagas (30 vagas) estarão disponíveis para competidores veteranos, por ordem de chegada.
* Se mais de 30 competidores novatos se inscreverem antes que 60 vagas sejam preenchidas por competidores veteranos, quaisquer novatos adicionais serão aceitos por ordem de chegada, juntamente com os competidores veteranos.
* Se as 30 vagas reservadas para novatos não forem preenchidas por novatos duas semanas antes da competição (até dia 2 de Março de 2025), as vagas restantes, até o limite de competidores, serão aceitas de competidores veteranos.

Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar.
Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com o delegado ([bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org)). 50% da taxa de inscrição será reembolsada se o competidor desistir até 9 de março de 2025.

As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Por favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.

# English
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:
* 50% of spots (30 spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 50% of spots (30 spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 30 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 30 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition (until March 2nd 2025), remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate.
In case of withdrawal, please contact the delegate ([bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org)). 50% of the register fee will be refunded if the competitor withdraw up until March 9 2025. 

Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: Drop-in Cubing Partille 2025
items.information:
Välkomna till Drop-in Cubing Partille 2025!

Detta är en speciell tävling som hålls under Pussel-SM, där deltagarna bjuds in att lära sig lösa kuben och testa på att tävla.
Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

**OBS**: Tävlingen är i en serie med Kungkuben 2025 som pågår samtidigt. Detta betyder att det inte är tillåtet att tävla i båda tävlingarna.

-----

Welcome to Drop-in Cubing Partille 2025!

This is a special competition held during the Swedish Jigsaw Puzzle Championship, where participants are invited to learn how to solve the cube and try competing for the first time.
Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

**Note**: This competition is part of a series with Kungkuben 2025. This means that it is not allowed to compete in both competitions.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: FMC French Championship 2025
items.information:
Merci de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#48026-faq) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). 
**ATTENTION** Cette compétition n'est PAS une compétition classique. Il n'y aura qu'une seule épreuve : la résolution optimisée (Fewest Moves), pendant laquelle la solution la plus courte à un mélange donné doit être trouvée et écrite sur une feuille en un temps maximum d'une heure. **Il n'y aura pas de 3x3 classique lors de cette compétition.**
 
----
Please **read the registration conditions, the [FAQ](#48026-faq) et the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab. 
**WARNING**  This competition is NOT a regular competition. There will be only one event: Fewest Moves, in which the shortest solution to a given scramble must be found and written on a sheet of paper in a maximum of one hour. **There will be no 3x3 in this competition.**

The registration fee includes admission into the Science Center for the competitor and one guest only. Additional guests will need to purchase tickets for admission to the Science Center. 
Ticket information is available at [LSC's website](https://lsc.org/buy-tickets/admission) - tickets for admission and additional LSC experiences can be purchased either online or on-site.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYxMDIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--ffdbf2d6c5dc55be39c684081050dc292e12ec88/LSC_Logo_New.png)
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 25 spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwOTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3eeb6c68eb32610efb332ea967640f7c06efad27/newcomer%202025.png)
Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

* 25 spots are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 50 spots are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 25 new competitors register before 50 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

## Welcome to the Malaysia Newcomer 2025!
[![Newcomer logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA4NzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--17cadd2ced923d2d26251d09fce733b54618627e/%EC%8A%A4%ED%81%AC%EB%A6%B0%EC%83%B7%202024-12-25%2000.10.29.png)](https://linktr.ee/newcomermonth)
[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/MalaysiaNewComer2025)

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:
- 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
- If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
- If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.**

All competitors are advised to review the information provided in the ["**Updates & Announcements**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaNewComer2025#54278-updates-announcements). New competitors, in particular, should carefully read the ["**New Competitors**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaNewComer2025#54279-new-competitors) for essential details before registering.

Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.

***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

**🇧🇷 Português:**

A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. No dia do campeonato, as inscrições serão aceitas apenas para a categoria 3x3x3.

A inscrição deve ser feita exclusivamente pelo site, com o pagamento antecipado da taxa via Stripe, diretamente na plataforma da WCA. A confirmação da inscrição no site da WCA ocorrerá somente após a validação do pagamento. Para mais detalhes, acesse a aba Inscrever.

Se tiver dificuldades para se inscrever, assista a este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) com instruções.
Antes da competição, leia atentamente o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem sua imagem em fotos e vídeos registrados durante o evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.


**🇺🇸 English:**

The competition is open to participants of all ages. On the day of the championship, registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 category.

Registration must be completed exclusively through the website, with the registration fee paid in advance via Stripe, directly on the WCA platform. Registration on the WCA website will only be confirmed after payment validation. For more details, visit the Register tab.

If you have any difficulties registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) for instructions.
Before the competition, please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) carefully.

By registering, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

## Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers Series

One day, two competitions! We are running this one-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 40% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2025** near the bottom of this page for more information).

You can choose between [Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MississaugaNewcomersA2025) and [Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MississaugaNewcomersB2025)! These competitions are identical except for the time of day they take place (morning or afternoon).

You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors.

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Rahn Education Open 2025
items.information:
**Deutsch**

Herzlich Willkommen zur **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig
Nach den ersten beiden Competitions 2023 und 2024 sowie den Rubik's German Nationals 2024 können wir **Leipzig** nun zu einem etablierten Cubing-Standort zählen. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet wieder eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. 

Diese Ausgabe der **Rahn Education Open** im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month richtet sich an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Bei der Anmeldung werden deshalb 43,75% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmende ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month".

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**


**English**

Welcome to the **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig
After the first two competitions in 2023 and 2024 and the Rubik's German Nationals 2024, we can now count **Leipzig** as an established cubing location. We, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. Once again, you can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig, a motivated organizing team and much more. 

This edition of the **Rahn Education Open** as part of the official WCA Newcomer Month is aimed at new and inexperienced cubers. When registering, 43.75% of the places will therefore be reserved for new participants. Participants without a WCA ID or with a WCA ID from the year 2025 are considered new participants. Returning participants have a WCA ID from the year 2024 or earlier. All participants must continue to fulfill all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. You can find more information on how registrations are accepted in the “Newcomer Month” tab.

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## Sponsorship

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png)

You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.

The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard.
Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information.

## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.

## NOTICE OF FILMING
Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.

## About CubingZA
CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.
If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwMTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--590d632186b67d440422c5a58d28b228cf84e84a/%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202024-12-25%2000.10.29.png)

이 대회는 WCA Newcomer Month 2025의 일환입니다. 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다. 이 때 첫 참가자란, WCA ID가 없거나 WCA ID가 2025로 시작하는 분들입니다. 기존 참가자(첫 참가자가 아닌 분)는 WCA ID가 2024 또는 그 이전의 숫자로 시작하는 분들입니다. 모든 참가자는 모든 등록 요건을 충족해야 등록이 완료된 것으로 간주됩니다. 

참가 신청은 다음 사항을 기준으로 수락됩니다:

- 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다.
- 나머지 50%는 기존 참가자에게 배정됩니다. 
- 기존 참가자가 정원의 50%를 채우기 전에 첫 참가자가 정원의 50% 이상 등록하면, 배정된 50% 안에 선착순에 의해 들지 못한 첫 참가자는 기존 참가자와 구분 없이 선착순으로 수락됩니다.
- 첫 참가자를 위한 자리가 대회 시작 2주 전 또는 참가 신청 기간 마감일이 되기 전에 모두 채워지지 않으면, 남은 자리는 기존 참가자들로부터 선착순으로 수락됩니다. 

---

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

- 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYzNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3108208eb7baaec4005983963bd4455293cbb240/1000049076.png)

### ČEŠTINA
Tato soutěž se účastní oficiálního Měsíce nováčků WCA 2025. Při registraci bude 50 % míst vyhrazeno pro nováčky. Za nováčky se považují ti, kteří ještě na své první WCA soutěži nebyli, nebo na ní byli v roce 2025 (nemají WCA ID, nebo mají WCA ID s rokem 2025). Za vracející se soutěžící se považujeme ty, kteří mají WCA ID s rokem 2024 a méně. Všichni soutěžící musí i nadále dodržet všechny registrační požadavky, aby jejich registrace byla považována za kompletní.

Registrace budou přijímány na základě následujících kritérií:

* 50 % míst je vyhrazeno pro nové soutěžící.
* Na zbylých 50 % míst budou přijati vracející se soutěžící podle pořadí přihlášení.
* Po obsazení vyhrazené kapacity pro nováčky budou na zbývající místa přijímáni jak vracející se soutěžící, tak nováčci, podle pořadí přihlášení.
* Nebude-li vyhrazená kapacita pro nováčky naplněna 2 týdny před začátkem soutěže, budou na tato místa přijímáni i vracející se soutěžící, dle pořadí registrace.

#### **Pódium pro nováčky** 
S potěšením oznamujeme, že v kategorii 3x3x3 budeme vyhlašovat pódium pro nové soutěžící. 


### ENGLISH
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50 % of spots for new competitors. * 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.

* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

#### **Newcomer podium** 
We are excited to announce that special podium awards will be presented to newcomers in the 3x3x3 event.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM0NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7f38aa440f2f5ea4ba0f22de16d4f6cdf4c47946/IMG-20250124-WA0034.jpg)
​
##### Español
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

¡Bienvenidos a **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**!

Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tus habilidades y conocimientos.

**¿Qué tan lejos puede llegar tu mente?**

El nombre del torneo y nuestra categoría principal no son coincidencia. Cada detalle ha sido pensado para resaltar la conexión entre la fuerza mental y el desafío que representa este evento.

El Megaminx, con su forma dodecaédrica, representa un verdadero desafío para la mente, exigiendo combinar estrategia, eficiencia, precisión, visión espacial y velocidad.

Así es como Megaminx se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes que pondrán a prueba tu mente.

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**.

Mega-Mente Puebla 2025 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).
​

##### English
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Welcome to **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**!

Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will challenge your knowledge and skills.

**How far can your mind go?**

The name of the tournament and our main category are no coincidence. Every detail has been carefully designed to highlight the connection between mental strength and the challenge this event represents.

The Megaminx, with its dodecahedral shape, embodies a true mental challenge, demanding a combination of strategy, efficiency, precision, spatial awareness, and speed.

This is why the Megaminx becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging categories that will put your mind to the test.

This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**.

Mega-Mind Puebla 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information:
**English**

**This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 50% of spots (60 spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 50% of spots (60 spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Deutsch**

**Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2025.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt.

**Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:**
* 50% der Plätze (60 Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert.
* 50% der Plätze (60 Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar.
* Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen.
* Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.name: Romandie Rookies 2025
items.information:
### WCA Newcomer Month

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg)

[FR]
C'est une compétition très accessible pour les débutants ! Tout le monde est le bienvenu mais si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition auparavant, c'est celle à laquelle vous devez vous inscrire !

Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024.

Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants :

50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi.
Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens.
Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous.

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Romandie Doigts Rapides 2025. Vous ne pouvez vous inscrire et participer qu'à l'une de ces compétitions.

[EN]
This is a very beginner-friendly competition! Everyone is welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for!

This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

This competition is a series competition with Romandie Doigtes Rapides 2025. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.

**Español**

¡Arica hace historia con su primer campeonato oficial de cubos Rubik!
Estamos emocionados de anunciar el primer torneo oficial de cubos Rubik en la ciudad más al norte de Chile. Este evento único ofrecerá la oportunidad de competir en 3 categorías oficiales, poniendo a prueba tu velocidad, destreza y concentración.

Ya seas un novato o un experto, este campeonato es tu momento para brillar en un ambiente lleno de entusiasmo y comunidad.

Arica makes history with its first official Rubik’s cube championship!
We are thrilled to announce the first official Rubik’s cube tournament in the northernmost city of Chile. This unique event offers the chance to compete in 3 official categories, testing your speed, skill, and focus.

Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned competitor, this championship is your time to shine in an atmosphere full of excitement and community.
Don’t miss this historic day in the City of Eternal Spring!

items.information:
### WCAシリーズ大会
「Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025/Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025/Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025」はWCAシリーズ大会です。
WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

このページは「Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025」のページです。
　・ [Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/)(**このページでは「AM大会」と表記**)
　・ [Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/)(**このページでは「PM大会」と表記**)
　・ [Tokyo Open FMC WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWInter2025/)(**このページでは「FMC大会」と表記**)

各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。
　・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 9:10　定員56名
　・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 13:00　定員56名
　・FMC大会：3x3x3 最小手数 1ラウンド、開場時刻 9:45　定員30名	 

### 当日の来場時刻
AM大会については、**必ず**受付時間内の9:10から9:30の間にお越しください。
PM大会については、開場時刻の13:00までは会場に入れません。**必ず**13:00から13:20の間にお越しください。
FMC大会については、開場時刻の9:45までは会場に入れません。**必ず**9:45から10:15の間にお越しください。
AM大会は9:20から、PM大会は13:20から競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーを行います。スピードキュービングの競技やジャッジ、ランナーを初めてなされる方は競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーにご参加ください。
※会場は他のイベントでも使用されている為、**会場前の廊下など建物内での待機はできません。**

### 参加費の支払い方法
参加費は受付時にお支払いください。
支払い方法は現金のみです。

### 競技者以外のご入場
会場定員の都合上、入場者の数を制限させていただいています。
見学者（競技の観戦だけをされる方）の入場は会場定員の都合上、受け付けていません。
競技者が未成年者や身体的サポートが必要な方の場合、会場までの移動のサポート及び会場での安全の確保のため**保護者・サポート者の方1名**まで同伴していただくことは可能です。競技者が成人の方で身体的サポートの必要がない場合は、同伴者（ご友人など）のご入場はできません。
なお後日、当日スタッフを募集する可能性があります。当日スタッフとして登録されたかたはご入場していただくことは可能です。

### ジャッジ・スクランブラー等の役割分担
WCA大会では、ご自身の競技参加のほか、他者の競技スタッフとしてジャッジやスクランブラ―をはじめとした役割が割り振られます。個人ごとの役割分担表は参加申し込み締め切り後にお伝えします。

競技参加者が年少者の場合など、自身での担当が困難なときには保護者などに代理でご協力いただくことがあります。具体的な作業の流れを確認する時間を大会当日に設けますので、不慣れな方は必ずご参加ください。
関連競技規則[1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1e2)および
競技規則[1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1f2)

★日本語が固まってから英語を修正

### WCA Series Competitions
Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025/Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025/Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025 are recongnized as WCA series competitions.
WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in  **only one** of them.
If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid.

This page is for Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025.
　[Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "AM"**)
　[Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "PM"**)
　[Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "FMC"**)

The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows:
　AM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 9:10, limit of competitors 56
　PM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 13:00, limit of competitors 56
　FMC：3x3x3 Fewest Moves 1 round, open at 9:45, limit of competitors 30
 
### Arrival Information
For the AM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:10 and 9:30.**
For the PM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 13:00 and 13:20.** Competitors won't be allowed to enter until 13:00. 
For the FMC competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:45 and 10:15.**
*Judge and runner lecture will be held at 9:20 for AM and 13:20 for PM. If this is your first time assigned as a judge or runner, please join the lecture session.
*The hallway is shared with other events/business. Please do not stay in the building hallway before check-in. 

### How to pay the participation fee
Please pay the participation fee at check-in.
Payment must be made in cash only.

### Limit of non-competitor Guest
We apply guest limitaion due to the venue capacity.
We do not accept spectors.

Underage competitors or those who has accessibility needs may **bring up to one non-competitor guest.**  Adults and those who do not have accessibilty needs please refrain from bringing guests into the venue.

We may request volunteer staffs for the competition in a later day. Those who are selected to be staffs will be accepted to enter the venue.

### The roles of judges and scramblers
According to regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must be prepared to perform duties as judges, scramblers and other roles required. 
For younger competitors or those unable to fulfill these roles, we may ask parents or guardians to assist on their behalf. Staff procedures will be lectured at the venue.

各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。
　・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 9:10　定員56名
　・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 13:00　定員56名
　・FMC大会：3x3x3 最小手数 1ラウンド、開場時刻 9:45　定員30名	 

### 当日の来場時刻
AM大会については、**必ず**受付時間内の9:10から9:30の間にお越しください。
PM大会については、開場時刻の13:00までは会場に入れません。**必ず**13:00から13:20の間にお越しください。
FMC大会については、開場時刻の9:45までは会場に入れません。**必ず**9:45から10:15の間にお越しください。
AM大会は9:20から、PM大会は13:20から競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーを行います。スピードキュービングの競技やジャッジ、ランナーを初めてなされる方は競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーにご参加ください。
※会場は他のイベントでも使用されている為、**会場前の廊下など建物内での待機はできません。**

### 参加費の支払い方法
参加費は受付時にお支払いください。
支払い方法は現金のみです。

### 競技者以外のご入場
会場定員の都合上、入場者の数を制限させていただいています。
見学者（競技の観戦だけをされる方）の入場は会場定員の都合上、受け付けていません。
競技者が未成年者や身体的サポートが必要な方の場合、会場までの移動のサポート及び会場での安全の確保のため**保護者・サポート者の方1名**まで同伴していただくことは可能です。競技者が成人の方で身体的サポートの必要がない場合は、同伴者（ご友人など）のご入場はできません。
なお後日、当日スタッフを募集する可能性があります。当日スタッフとして登録されたかたはご入場していただくことは可能です。

### ジャッジ・スクランブラー等の役割分担
WCA大会では、ご自身の競技参加のほか、他者の競技スタッフとしてジャッジやスクランブラ―をはじめとした役割が割り振られます。個人ごとの役割分担表は参加申し込み締め切り後にお伝えします。

競技参加者が年少者の場合など、自身での担当が困難なときには保護者などに代理でご協力いただくことがあります。具体的な作業の流れを確認する時間を大会当日に設けますので、不慣れな方は必ずご参加ください。
関連競技規則[1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1e2)および
競技規則[1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1f2)

★日本語が固まってから英語を修正

### WCA Series Competitions
Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025/Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025/Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025 are recongnized as WCA series competitions.
WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in  **only one** of them.
If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid.

This page is for Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025.
　[Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "AM"**)
　[Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "PM"**)
　[Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "FMC"**)

The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows:
　AM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 9:10, limit of competitors 56
　PM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 13:00, limit of competitors 56
　FMC：3x3x3 Fewest Moves 1 round, open at 9:45, limit of competitors 30
 
### Arrival Information
For the AM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:10 and 9:30.**
For the PM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 13:00 and 13:20.** Competitors won't be allowed to enter until 13:00. 
For the FMC competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:45 and 10:15.**
*Judge and runner lecture will be held at 9:20 for AM and 13:20 for PM. If this is your first time assigned as a judge or runner, please join the lecture session.
*The hallway is shared with other events/business. Please do not stay in the building hallway before check-in. 


### How to pay the participation fee
Please pay the participation fee at check-in.
Payment must be made in cash only.

### Limit of non-competitor Guest
We apply guest limitaion due to the venue capacity.
We do not accept spectors.

Underage competitors or those who has accessibility needs may **bring up to one non-competitor guest.**  Adults and those who do not have accessibilty needs please refrain from bringing guests into the venue.

We may request volunteer staffs for the competition in a later day. Those who are selected to be staffs will be accepted to enter the venue.

### The roles of judges and scramblers
According to regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must be prepared to perform duties as judges, scramblers and other roles required. 
For younger competitors or those unable to fulfill these roles, we may ask parents or guardians to assist on their behalf. Staff procedures will be lectured at the venue.

### **IMPORTANTE**
Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo.

* Revisar la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanValencubeHuancayo2025#53125-registro-registration) para conocer el método de registro.
* Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanValencubeHuancayo2025#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo.
* Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanValencubeHuancayo2025/register)
* Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo.
[Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY)
[Tutorial para competidores nuevos - Jael Riggenbach](https://www.facebook.com/100000565031843/videos/3156907307906324/)
•
* Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.

 
### **IMPORTANT**
You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament.

*  Check [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanValencubeHuancayo2025#53125-registro-registration) to know the registration method.
*  Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanValencubeHuancayo2025#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram.
*   To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanValencubeHuancayo2025/register)
*   We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted.
[WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)
•
* It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.name: Trikala Open 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQ1NTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c770014c6db789e76c32778326e0f6980f437a47/466472712_1925266651296844_7482586112726949324_n.jpg)

Το Trikala Open 2025 θα είναι o πρωτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 στην πανέμορφη και υπερσύγχρονη πόλη των Τρικάλων! Στο αμφιθεατρικά χτισμένο ξενοδοχείο Ananti Resort & Spa, σε αίθουσα με πανοραμική θέα στην πόλη, θα διαγωνιστούν για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο.
Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)


The Trikala Open 2025 will be the first official competition in Greece for 2025, held in the beautiful and ultra-modern city of Trikala! At the amphitheatrically built Ananti Resort & Spa, in a hall with panoramic views of the city, Cubers of all ages and skill levels, both newcomers and veterans, from across the country and beyond, will compete for two days.
Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for yet another celebration of cubing!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다.
### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/56/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/56/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오.
### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/56/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/56/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list.
### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

- On-site registrations will not be accepted.
- Try to have a lot of fun!

# Português

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças.

**COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição**

As inscrições custam R$ 35,00 (trinta e cinco reais) e se encerram no dia 22 de janeiro de 2025 às 23h59min (horário local). A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail, com todas as informações solicitadas).

O pagamento da inscrição não dá direito a acompanhantes. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores  de 16 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento, preferencialmente antecipadamente.

O espaço comporta apenas 35 acompanhantes no total, de modo que reservamos 1 acompanhante por competidor. Caso você queira levar mais de 1 acompanhante, sugerimos garantir vaga do 1o acompanhante e colocar os demais na lista de espera. Ao término das inscrições, entraremos em contato informando caso sobrem vagas de acompanhantes, para que você exerça a opção de levar mais. 

Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 45,00 (quarenta e cinco reais), caso haja vagas.

Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 20,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas.

**Modalidade não-oficial:** Este campeonato contará com uma modalidade extra e inovadora: Skewb OH (com uma mão)

# English

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge.

**ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

**FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition**

Registration costs R$35.00 (thirty five Brazilian reais) and close on January 22, 2025 at 23:59 (local time). Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof) by e-mail, with all the information required).

Payment of registration fee  does not guarantee the competitor a companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 16, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event, preferably in advance.

The space can only hold 35 companions in total, so we reserve 1 companion per competitor. If you would like to bring more than 1 companion, we suggest that you secure a place for the 1st companion and put the others on the waiting list. At the end of registration, we'll contact you to let you know if there are any places left, so that you can choose to bring more.

On-site registrations will be accepted for R$45.00 (fourty five Brazilian reais), if there are still places.

Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places.

**Unofficial Event:** This competition will count with an extra and innovative event: Skewb OH (one-handed)

items.information:
Wellington Mind Games 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

**The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

#### BIENVENIDOS A LA PRIMER PARADA DE LA RUTA CUBERA 2025, IZCALLI CLÁSICO
Después de 6 años México regresa a tener una ruta cubera, por 3 ciudadades alrededor del país, siendo la primera Cuautitlán Izcalli en el Estado de México, con nuestro querido torneo Clásico!
Habrá sorpresas para todos aquellos que completen la Ruta Cubera 2025, así que no dejes que se te vaya la primer parada, prepara tus mejores 3x3 y 2x2, te esperamos en Izcalli!.

Un agradecimiento especial a las FES-Cuautitlán UNAM por las facilidades y apoyo para realizar este evento, y al Team Izcalli por el compromiso para poderlo llevar a cabo.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

#### WELCOME TO THE FIRST STOP OF THE CUBER ROUTE 2025, IZCALLI CLASICO
After 6 years, Mexico returns to have a cuba route, through 3 cities around the country, the first being Cuautitlán Izcalli in the State of Mexico, with our beloved Classic tournament!
There will be surprises for all those who complete the Cuber 2025 Route, so don't let the first stop pass you by, prepare your best 3x3 and 2x2, we are waiting for you in Izcalli!

We thank the FES-Cuautitlán UNAM for the facilities and support to hold this event and to the izcalli team for the commitment to be able to carry it out.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA regulations before the competition. [](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

###### Español 
¡Bienvenidos al Ameca Nayarit 2025, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso entorno costero y tropical de Nuevo Nayarit, y la segunda en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas! Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo los dias 18 y 19 de enero del 2025.

A medida que el río fluye, también lo hará la emoción de ver a los competidores resolver el cubo Rubik con asombrosa rapidez. Prepárense para estas jornadas inolvidables llenas de ingenio y velocidad.

Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad de Vallarta Speed.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

###### English
Welcome to the Ameca Nayarit 2025, the first official competition in the beautiful coastal and tropical environment of Nuevo Nayarit, and the second in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place on January 18 and 19, 2025.

As the river flows, so will the thrill of watching competitors solve the Rubik's Cube with astonishing speed. Get ready for these unforgettable days full of ingenuity and speed.

This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community.

This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information:
### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다.
### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/55/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/55/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오.
### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/55/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/55/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list.
### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.information:
##Português:

**Competidores, atenção aos seguintes avisos:**

- Esta competição *não terá a modalidade*  ***3x3x3*** ;
- Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**;
- O competidor poderá se inscrever antecipadamente pelo site e sua inscrição será confirmada apenas com o pagamento da taxa via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, após isso enviar comprovante para o mesmo e-mail, contendo o print do comprovante e o nome do competidor.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**Caso o limite de 28 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$21, por ordem de chegada**

##English:

**Competitors, heed the following warnings:**

- This competition *will NOT have* the ***3x3x3*** event;
- This competition will have a limit on competitors. Register only if you are **sure that you will participate**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**;
- The competitor may register in advance on the website and their registration will only be confirmed upon payment of the fee via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, after which send proof of registration to the same email, containing the print of the proof of registration and the name of the competitor.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**If the competitor limit of 28 isn't reached, we will be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$21, in order of arrival**

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.
